title: S05T01 - Define the specification and change adapter contract
description: Model current specification, proposed change, design, scenarios, tasks, deltas, status, archive, provenance, and adapter capabilities as source-backed Boreal references.
acceptanceCriteria: The adapter contract is provider-neutral, versioned, bounded, and preserves artifact URIs and content hashes without copying untrusted text into instructions.
Boreal clearly separates authoritative current behavior, proposed deltas, implementation work, and archived change history.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
